env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^Name=5$'
stdout '^Count=10$'
stdout '^Ok=15$'
stdout '^15 <nil>$'
stdout '^0 bad z$'
stdout '^27$'
stdout '^\[nm ct\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go

! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep 'Tag\.Get' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectcfi

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
	Ok    bool
}

func parse(s string) (int, error) {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, errors.New("bad " + s)
	}
	return n, nil
}

func total(in string) (int, error) {
	sum := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		n := parse(in)?
		sum += n
		fmt.Println($"{f.Name}={sum}")
	}
	return sum, nil
}

func summed() int {
	s := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		s += []int{1, 2, 3}.map(x => x + f.Index).sum()
	}
	return s
}

type Tagged struct {
	Name  string `json:"nm"`
	Count int    `json:"ct"`
}

func tags() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Tagged]() {
		out = append(out, f.Tag.Get("json"))
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(total("5"))
	fmt.Println(total("z"))
	fmt.Println(summed())
	fmt.Println(tags())
}
